summary: Both frozen target coverage obligations arise with the added deferral behavior. The old harness cannot reach either behavior after the change.

claims.necessity_reason: The after source supports deferred retry during incremental parsing, while the harness provides no later nonfinal call on the same parser.

before.requirement: Reach a deferred retry on a later nonfinal continuation after an incomplete token.
before.reason: The before ParseBuffer calls the processor directly; the deferral helper is absent from the verified preimage.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The verified preimage has no callProcessor definition.

after.requirement: Reach a deferred retry on a later nonfinal continuation after an incomplete token.
after.reason: ParseBuffer now calls the deferral helper, but the harness makes only one nonfinal XML_Parse call per parser.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The helper defines the nonfinal partial-token retry threshold.

claims.comparison_reason: The same deferred-retry tuple is absent before and supported but unreachable after; no preexisting defect is substituted.

claims.necessity_reason: The after source permits a child parser to inherit XML_FALSE deferral, but the harness never sets XML_FALSE on its parent.

before.requirement: Create an external-entity child inheriting disabled reparse deferral from its parent.
before.reason: The before child-creation function has no deferral setting to copy, and the setter is absent from the verified preimage.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The verified preimage has no XML_SetReparseDeferralEnabled definition.

after.requirement: Create an external-entity child inheriting disabled reparse deferral from its parent.
after.reason: The setter accepts XML_FALSE and child creation copies the parent setting; the harness creates children without calling the setter.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The setter establishes XML_FALSE on the parent.
The after documentation describes the selectable deferral behavior.

claims.comparison_reason: The same child-inheritance tuple is unavailable before and supported but unreachable after; the setter is a prerequisite of that tuple.
